state_defects_and_gaps_reported.title: BLIND WALL BREACH - the brain view serves a blind g22 specialist the realized outcome for its own day
state_defects_and_gaps_reported.what_is_in_it: plays[].instances[] carry dated realized dollar outcomes for days INSIDE the forecast window. Verbatim from the served view for my day: '20260622 (Mon): day_move +650 USD - gap +1210 + session net -560 - closing at cum_from_anchor +650. The block-open Monday and the largest seam gap of the modern walk'. Also present: 'roughly $430 of the $1,210 is the leg change'; '0622 forecast +20 actual +1,210'; '0622 session err 120 while its gap missed by 1,190'; and verbatim quotes of the prior blind and refine posteriors for 20260622.
state_defects_and_gaps_reported.extent: 57 occurrences of '20260622' and 100 of '0622' in the served view; 33 of '1,210'. The same exposure covers 20260629, 20260706, 20260713 and the g23 window - i.e. every day of both remaining staged groups.
state_defects_and_gaps_reported.root_cause: brain_view.py scopes by SECTION only. There is no instance-level date filter against the group being forecast. The S112 stamping put 624 dated instances into the brain, and every merge since has added realized outcomes; nothing strips them at serve time.
state_defects_and_gaps_reported.the_false_assertion_that_hides_it: brain_view.py's own module docstring, lines 20-21: 'Not a security boundary and not a blind wall - D2's one deliberate mask is the PRICE CURVE, and the brain carries no price.' That was true when written and is FALSE as of s105.7. The brain now carries realized price moves in dollars, dated, for the exact days being forecast, and the comment is what would stop a reviewer from looking.
state_defects_and_gaps_reported.consequence: No blind run on g22 or g23 produced from this view is evidence of anything. My own day-move of +650 matches the leaked actual exactly and I cannot certify it as independently derived. This is the same class as S108's filename collision and S109's hole #11: present, well-formed, right owner, and carrying the answer.
state_defects_and_gaps_reported.fix_proposed: (1) brain_view.py takes the group's date window (and the anchor day) and REDACTS or drops any instances[] entry whose date field intersects it, printing the count redacted so the absence announces itself per the file's own doctrine. (2) Delete the 'the brain carries no price' claim from the docstring. (3) A stage-time assertion in state_health / verify_gold that hard-fails a blind spawn whose brain view contains any in-window date, negative-tested by EMITTING the redaction count, not by checking that the code parses (D11 violation, S110 NC-3).

state_defects_and_gaps_reported.fix_proposed: the anchor block states the leg of the 3.198 EXPLICITLY, states whether a roll adjustment was applied and of what size, and carries a leg_change_usd field that is zero when clean. Same shape as the existing direction_caveat and provenance fields, which are exemplary.
